description: Anonymised unique customer key (C00001-C00500); no PII.
Number of purchases made by the customer (1-50).
Days since the customer's most recent purchase (1-1091). Higher = less recently active.
Average value of one order, in currency units.
Lifetime spend. In this file it equals frequency x recency_days exactly (synthetic artefact), so it is excluded from model inputs.
Provided CLV estimate; used as the regression target.
Date of most recent purchase (YYYY-MM-DD). 39 rows fall after 2026-10-26 and do not match recency_days.
Provided label: Premium/Regular/Occasional/Churned. Shows no relationship with behaviour in the data, so replaced by RFM-based value_tier.
